units: Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 21.—Trnsf. (of a charm) to vanish, be broken.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:18">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>כי מטא לאשקויי מייא פ׳ וכ׳</he> when he came (to a river) to let the ass drink, it disappeared (the charm was broken), and there stood a landing board (v. <cite ref="A00795"><he>אוּסְקָנִיתָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 11:7">Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 7</cite>.

senses.gloss: to solve a riddle or a dream; to interpret.
units: Ib. XLI, 12; a. fr. (in O. ed. Berl. interch. with Pa.).—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>דלמא דאתון</he> (<he>חדא איתתא</he>) <he>רבתי חכימין למִיפְשַׁר חלמא וכ׳</he> do you understand how to interpret a dream which I had as well as your master?; a. e.

senses.gloss: to disengage, tear loose. Pesik. Shek., p. 11ᵃ דאת מְפַשֵּׁר לה וכ׳ (not ליה) which thou makest loose here &c., v. preced. a. סִירְתָּא; Yalk. Prov. 953; Yalk. Ex. 386.—Snh. l. c. פַּשְּׁרָה לה (Ms. K. פַּשַּׁרְתָּהּ) she released (disenchanted) her.

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:15">Targ. O. Gen. XLI, 15</cite> <he>וּמְפַשַּׁר</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. <he>לְמִפְשַׁר</he>). Ib. XL, 16; a. fr. (v. supra).—
Targ. Cant. II, 5 (some ed. מַפְשַׁר Af.).—

<cite ref="Yoma 28b:11">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא חלים והוא מפשר</he> did he dream and himself interpret?, i.e. did he answer his own query? <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:2">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מפשר חלמי הוה</he> was an interpreter of dreams; <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:2">ib.</cite> <he>מפשר ליה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C01339"><he>גְּרִיעוּתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד כות׳</he> 1) <he>חד … עביד נפשיה מפשר חלמין</he> a certain Samaritan professed to be an interpreter of dreams; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְפַשַּׁר</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55b:7">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>חלמא דלא מפ׳ וכ׳</he> a dream not interpreted is like a letter not read (has no effect).

senses.gloss: to release, settle with. Y. Keth. X, end, 34ᵃ [read as Asheri to Keth. 91ᵇ:] קום פַּשֵּׁר (or פַּשְּׁרִין) rise and settle with me; יכיל מומר ליה פַּשְּׁרִין ואי טרף טרף he may say to him, settle with me, and if he (the prior creditor) should seize (what you give me in settlement), he may seize it. Pesik. Shub., p. 164ᵇ פשר פריטך settle thy account; a. e.
to be released. Ib. עד זמן דמִתְפַּשּׁר פריטוי until he has redeemed his debt; וכיון דנתפשר וכ׳ (read: דאתפשר) and when his account was settled (v. סְפַן).
